All 4 dashboard cards render with correct values from backend (Gastos del mes Q3136 / Mes anterior Q0 / Top categoría Alquiler Q3136 / Pendientes Q0). All 3 tabs switch and load. Form dialog (ExpenseFormDialog) opens with category dropdown showing all 10 Spanish-labeled options; supplier autocomplete from /clinic/inventory/suppliers works (typed 'TEST' → resolved to TEST_Supplier_1777156034); created a Suministros expense (amount 500 + IVA 60 = total Q560 visible live) and saw 'Gasto registrado' toast then row appeared in list with category 'Suministros', supplier name link 'TEST_Supplier_1777156034', total Q560, status 'Pagado'. minor.issue: N+1 query: per supplier_id does an extra SELECT on suppliers table (line 4877). For clinics with many supplier-tagged expenses this scales poorly. Recommend a single PostgREST embed (e.g., select('total,supplier_id,suppliers(name)')) or RPC view.

Recomputes everything in Python by fetching ALL expenses for the clinic on every dashboard hit (no date prefilter on the SELECT). Will become slow as expense table grows; recommend pre-filtering in SQL with month boundaries and grouping at DB layer.
label list iteration line 4852 has O(N*K) inner loop counting per category (sum(1 for x in rows if ...)). Trivial for current volumes but should aggregate in single pass.
No file-size cap on UploadFile.read(). Malicious or accidental upload of huge files would buffer into memory before storage. Recommend MAX_BYTES check (e.g., 10MB) before uploading to Supabase.
Does not validate payment_status enum on update (only payment_method + category are validated). Caller could PUT payment_status='BOGUS' and corrupt the row.
Hard-deletes row but does NOT delete the attachment file from Supabase Storage. Orphan files accumulate in {clinic_id}/expenses/{expense_id}/.

issues: Date filter inputs use native <input type='date'> (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn Calendar popover — recurring carryover across modules.

CategoryReportTab defaults to current-month range (line ~390s) so newly-created expenses with custom past dates (e.g., 2026-01-15 while today is April) won't appear until user widens date range. Could be confusing; consider defaulting to a wider range or a quick date-range chooser (Mes/Trimestre/Año).
Form dialog: 'Total' field is read-only computed but visually styled as a regular form cell — could be slightly more prominent (e.g., a card or contrasting bg) to emphasize live recompute.

action_items: RECOMMEND (LOW): add payment_status enum validation in PUT /clinic/expenses/{id} (currently can be set to any string).
RECOMMEND (LOW): cap upload file size in /attachment endpoint (e.g., 10MB) before reading into memory.
RECOMMEND (LOW): on DELETE /clinic/expenses/{id}, also remove storage file at {clinic_id}/expenses/{id}/ to avoid orphan files in the patient-files bucket.
RECOMMEND (LOW): replace native <input type='date'> in filter rows + form Fecha field with shadcn Calendar popover (consistent with sales/AR module recommendations).
RECOMMEND (LOW): collapse N+1 in /by-supplier into a single PostgREST embed (suppliers(name)) for performance.
RECOMMEND (LOW): widen default date range on Por categoría tab or add 'Mes/Trimestre/Año' presets — currently defaults to current month and hides cross-month data.
OPTIONAL: refactor server.py expenses endpoints (lines 4799-5064, 265 lines) into /app/backend/routers/expenses.py — server.py is now 5086 lines.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5086 lines — every CRM module added monotonically. Strongly recommend extracting routers per resource (sales, ar, expenses, inventory, agenda).
expenses_dashboard fetches the entire expenses table for a clinic on every hit — for clinics with thousands of expense rows this is slow. Use SQL date filtering and group_by at DB layer.
PUT /expenses missing payment_status enum validation despite POST having it — inconsistency creates a path to corrupt enum values.
Hard-delete on /expenses with no soft-delete or audit log + orphans Supabase Storage files. For accounting data this is risky; consider soft-delete (is_deleted flag) or archived_at timestamp.

EXPENSE_CATEGORIES list and EXPENSE_CATEGORY_LABELS mapping live in server.py and CATEGORIES list lives in ExpensesPage.js — duplicated mapping. Consider exposing via /api/clinic/expenses/categories endpoint to keep frontend/backend in sync.
